- Escalations: SLA path is Triage (1h) -> Eng oncall (4h) -> Exec notify (8h). I recommend we keep the Exec notify at 8h for pilot only.
- Playbook: updated play 4 (incident + rollback) — link in Drive and excerpt below.

Known risks: chat backend latency spikes seen during internal load test (small window, mitigated by KV cache tweak). Ops is aware and monitoring.

Forwarding the play excerpt: 

"If a generator timeout > 500ms observed on >5% of requests for 3 consecutive 5‑min windows, route new sessions to model variant B and open an incident."

- Fallback: model variant B is warmed and validated; automatic routing will shift new sessions only (no cold migration).
- Monitoring: added synthetic checks for 99p latency, will surface on the Command Center dashboard.

5) Docs & Command Center (Kimberly) — Top pages: QuickStart, Troubleshooting, Admin Guide; Kimberly to surface any critical gaps by Mon 5/24. Owner: Kimberly (deliverable: link list).

Next steps: I will produce a one‑page Command Center brief and attach to the QBR deck. Please add any final edits in the Drive file by EOD Mon 5/24.
